messages:
sara (Marketing): Heads-up 1 uploaded the latest blog draft for the product launch to Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-draft-v5. Short pass needed on: 1) main audience hook (PM vs infra), 2) benchmark claim language + methodology link, 3) webinar CTA routing + capacity. Can people flag blockers quickly? :eyes:

kai (Product): Reading now. My suggestion: open with a 1-line value prop for PMs, then include an infra highlight box with the benchmark numbers and a short methodology callout. Two CTA flows is ideal but keep a single form underneath.

ben (Growth): Agree on single form + hidden segment field. Use `?seg=pm` or `?seg=infra` to set audience_segment. We can map to HubSpot workflows: PM -> wf_launch_pm_2026; Infra -> wf_launch_infra_2026. Ill paste a tiny snippet below for the form.

ivy (Design): I can build two hero variants that swap copy and microvisuals based on ?seg=. Also can create a small feature->buyer table to help routing. ETA ~2h.

mona (Legal): Quick redline: avoid absolutes. Use "up to" and name baseline explicitly (e.g., "NVIDIA A100 40GB baseline"). Must include a benchmark link and a brief methodology note listing model family, seq len, batching, hardware. Add one-line disclaimer under numeric claims: "Results may vary by workload and deployment."

sara (Marketing): Ben 1 drop the HubSpot snippet and confirm workflow IDs. Kai 1 propose the 2-line PM opener and the benchmark sentence to match Legal's guidance. Ivy 1 confirm seat counts for the webinar so we can wire capacity handling.

ben (Growth): Snippet (single form, hidden segment): `<form action="https://forms.hubspot.com/submit/LAUNCHX"><input type="hidden" name="audience_segment" value="__SEG__"><input name="email" type="email" required><button>Reserve seat</button></form>` Replace __SEG__ with pm or infra via `?seg=` param. Workflows: wf_launch_pm_2026, wf_launch_infra_2026. Tag: launch_2026_batchC.

kai (Product): PM opener suggestion: "Ship LLM features faster 1 Redwood abstracts serving so product teams ship prompts, routing, and monitoring in days, not months." Benchmark sentence: "Internal tests show up to 25% lower per-token latency vs NVIDIA A100 40GB baseline and up to 30% lower per-request GPU cost (internal benchmark, May 2026; see methodology)." I added a 2-line methodology box in the doc.

mona (Legal): That phrasing is acceptable if the benchmark doc link and methodology are in the post and we include the disclaimer. Remove any language implying guaranteed savings.

ivy (Design): Webinar seats available = 220. ben, can reg-bot flip CTA to "Join waitlist" at 200 and hard-cap at 220? I'll style waitlist CTA orange and add a tiny capacity counter next to the CTA.

bен (Growth): Roger. reg-bot can be configured to post counts and trigger the CMS swap.

reg-bot: Config updated: warn_threshold=200, waitlist_threshold=200, hard_cap=220. Will post counts at 150, 200, and when full. Will emit CMS hook to swap CTA when waitlist threshold is reached.

sara (Marketing): Great. Mona 1 final check: I'll add the methodology link and the one-line disclaimer: "Results from internal benchmarks; actual results may vary depending on workload and deployment." After that I'll fold design assets and re-upload by EOD for comms copy lock tomorrow morning. :rocket:
